hook.text: A robot navigates around a forklift, avoids a puddle, and delivers a tote to station 7. No guide rails.

buildup.text: AMRs use sensors, cameras, and AI to navigate warehouses without tracks, wires, or magnets.

discovery.text: They adapt to changing layouts and congestion in real time. Install them in days, not months.

twist.text: AMRs work well on flat floors. Uneven surfaces, ramps, and outdoor areas still challenge them.

climax.text: Locus Robotics AMRs helped a warehouse double throughput during peak season without adding staff.

punchline.text: No rails, no wires. Just smart robots on wheels.

quiz.question: How do AMRs differ from older automated vehicles?
options: They navigate without tracks or guide wires
